entries.title: Character identity sheet

inputs.purpose: Supply approved visual and narrative identity evidence.

entries.outputIntent: A canonical project-local character sheet that records identity, silhouette, wardrobe, proportions, and mutable state.
guidance: Separate invariant identity traits from shot- or scene-specific state.
Include readable front, profile, and three-quarter evidence when the source supports them.
Record wardrobe components, scale cues, and forbidden substitutions in structured fields.
verifyCriteria: Invariant and mutable attributes are distinguishable.
Every retained view points to a real project-local image.
Forbidden substitutions are explicit where identity could drift.
incompatibilities: A prose-only identity description when visual evidence exists
Temporary shot state stored as an invariant trait

entries.title: Location and prop sheet

inputs.purpose: Supply approved environment or prop evidence and story function.

entries.outputIntent: A canonical location or prop sheet that preserves geography, scale, material, light direction, and interaction constraints.
guidance: Record entrances, exits, landmarks, blocking zones, and stable screen-direction anchors.
Separate fixed geometry from dressable or destructible state.
For a story prop, record ownership, hand, orientation, state transitions, and scale references.
verifyCriteria: Coverage can preserve geography from the recorded anchors.
Every image reference resolves inside the project.
incompatibilities: A mood image without navigable geography
A prop description that omits state or scale when either changes

entries.title: Style contract sheet

inputs.purpose: Supply the accepted references and decisions that define the look.

entries.outputIntent: A compact style contract within canonical project state, separating invariants, controlled ranges, and explicit exclusions.
guidance: Record composition, camera, shape, material, light, color, texture, and motion as independent dimensions.
Mark each dimension as invariant, controlled range, or intentionally variable.
Describe exclusions as observable failures rather than named-provider behavior.
verifyCriteria: Every invariant is observable in an approved reference or explicit decision.
Allowed variation is bounded enough to review consistently.
incompatibilities: A style contract defined only by a brand or artist name
Provider-specific request syntax or capability claims

entries.title: Continuity state sheet

inputs.purpose: Supply the canonical beat and shot order whose state must be tracked.

entries.outputIntent: An appendable continuity ledger embedded in canonical project state, not a competing production bible.
guidance: Track wardrobe, hair, makeup, carried objects, damage, dirt, wetness, time, weather, and light state only where relevant.
Bind each state transition to the beat or shot that causes it.
Keep unresolved discrepancies explicit until a canonical decision closes them.
verifyCriteria: Every changed state has a prior cause or an explicit discontinuity decision.
A shot can derive its entering state from the ledger.
The ledger supplements rather than duplicates canonical phase artifacts.
incompatibilities: State changes recorded without an owning beat or shot

provenance.adaptation: Converted copy-ready prose into structured sheet intents that populate existing canonical project state; no parallel production-bible artifact was introduced.
